title: Cocktail Menu
text:
Session 1: Moscow Mule - picking up illicit goods Session 2: Old fashioned - Drunk by ray before the chase Session 3: No 10. Manhattan - Train reference Session 4.: Spilt milk - Amalfi leaves Session 5: Poet’s dream. Night market cocktail incoming Session 6: the one where we rescue the dude Session 7, 13/06/2026: Corpse Reviver - Dead rising in warehouse Session 8, 20/09/2026: The Last word - Alexi’s death and a bitter last word from Dom Session 9, 27/09/2026: The Gypsy Queen Session 10, : Session 11, 1/11/2026:


  
    
      
    
    Car Crash #2
    
      The gang tries to enter the night market, but are denied. 
      Got to go get those fae booze they ditched. 
      Dom has a car crash that puts him into coma. 
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Gypsy Queen
    
      Ray identifies Alexi's body. 
      Dom asks the Gypsy for help. 
      The gypsy matron reveals the truth about Anna. 
      Anna goes missing. red identifies she has been banished to the shadow realm!
    
  

  
    
      
    
    The Last Word
    
      Alexi and Dom have a falling out. Dom leave the gang. 
      Alexi is informed by the Gypsy that Zapitovi is a fae. 
      Alexi reveals that Zapitovi was killed 10 years ago. 
      Anna gets her fortune read by the Gypsy. 
      Then Alexi is blown up in a car bomb.
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Corpse Reviver
    
      After tracking down the Capitani who kidnapped some Golikov men, 
      The gang massacre the lot and once again kill Zapitovi. 
      Then all the dead are resurrected. 
    
  
  
  
    
      
    
    Dark N Stormy
    
      After tracking down the Capitani who muscled in on Golikov turf, 
      The Gypsy gets the drop and slashes some faces. 
      Ray and Red burn all their cars. 
      The kidnapped Golikov gang member probably died...
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Poet's Dream
    
      The gang head to the dream like, fae night market. 
      Raymond meets Felix the cat. 
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Spilt Milk
    
      Amalfi want more pay. Doesn't realise Alexi wants him to join the gang proper. 
      He runs. Someone has been messing with Golikov racketeering. 
      Red and Dom track down the Capitani dogs. 
      We introduce the Gypsy. 
    
  

  
    
      
    
    No. 10 Manhattan
    
      The gang board a train to retrieve more fae booze. 
      The Booze is cursed by Zapitovi. 
      The train is hijacked, Dom and Amalfi have to jump from the train. 
      Ray and Red ditch the booze in South side.
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Old Fashioned
    
      The gang kill Capitani thugs and Zapitovi and the brothel. 
      Returning with the goods. 
    
  

  
    
      
    
    Moscow Mule
    
      The gang track down fae booze in a Capitani brothel
